notes.title: Exhale XR's Exciting App Update: Free DLCs & Enhanced Interactions
notes.content:
Greetings to the Exhale XR Community,

[b]Big news from Exhale XR! [/b]

We're making significant changes based on your valuable feedback. Here’s what to expect starting December 1st, 2023:

[b]Free DLC Transition:[/b] Over 35 DLC titles will shift from paid to free, making our resources more accessible for wellness.

[b]DLC Retirement:[/b] Concurrently, we will retire 28 DLC titles to refine our offerings.

[b]Comprehensive Update:[/b] These DLC changes are part of a broader update to the Exhale XR app, enhancing in-app interactions for a more dynamic user experience.


We apologize for any inconvenience these changes may cause. Rest assured, any purchased but discontinued retreats can still be enjoyed via 360 video player app. Curious which retreats are staying and which are being retired? [url=https://www.exhalexr.com/post/elevating-your-journey]Click here for a full list[/url]

[b]Terms of Exchange:[/b] Users who purchased any of these soon-to-be-free DLCs between October 1st 2022 and November 30th, 2023, can exchange them for a complimentary guided meditation or spoken word experience. Details for this exchange can be found below.
[b]To Exchange a DLC:[/b]
Email us at info@exhalexr.com with:

1) Your Steam username.
2) The name and proof of purchase of the retreat.
3) The title of the guided meditation or spoken word experience you’d like to receive.

We're excited about these updates and are committed to enhancing your wellness journey with Exhale XR. Thank you for being a part of our community as we move into this new chapter. 

Warm regards,
The Exhale XR Team

notes.title: v01.00.07 - Bug Patch - Elevator and Installed DLC check
notes.content:
[h3][b]Build Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]DLC would not play from the panel.[/b] We have implemented a quick check to see if the DLC file is completely installed and in the correct location before going into the video player. If a problem still occurs, please check that all your DLC are installed and the install is verified through steam.

[*] [b]Elevator not working.[/b] The elevator had a reported bug where it would not activate under some conditions. We have made this process much easier to start and control.
[/list]
We are very passionate about this experience as well as your experience with Exhale. We are planning more improvements as soon as possible. Thank you for your valuable feedback and patience as we tackle the problems that arise.

notes.title: Veterans Day Giveaway
notes.content:
Are you a veteran or active duty military? Do you have a VR headset? Are you interested in trying VR for relaxation or as an aid for PTSD and anxiety? If you answered yes to these questions then you are just the person we think could benefit from the Exhale XR experience.  

Let's do it! How can I be one of the 5 winners? Simple…
1-Join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2014990/discussions/1/4783413655228259311/]Veterans for VR relaxation[/url] group
2-Follow the Exhale XR [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2014990]community hub[/url]
3-Briefly share your most relaxing place and experienced senses of a memory in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2014990/discussions/1/]“Veterans Giveaway Forum”[/url].

[b]Begins: [/b]11-11-2022 
[b]Ends:[/b] 11-15-2022 11:59 EST
[i]We will be announcing the winners on 11-18-2022 through the community announcement board and DM.[/i]

[b]Our thanks:[/b]
As a recognition for all of the sacrifices of a normal life you make to defend our freedoms we are forever grateful. Part of our mission here at Exhale XR is to provide a quality space for those who are in most need of a peaceful world to just exist in, with no expectation for sacrifice or strife, even if it’s only for a few moments at a time. The world exists now for anyone looking to find it. 
Veterans, active military and civilian first responders rank at the top of our “who are we designing this app for” list. That being said we will be holding more giveaways moving into 2023 which are directed at getting the app into the hands of those who could use it most. If you miss out on this one please be sure to follow us for all of the giveaways and contests to come.

[b]Giveaway Rules:[/b]
-Purchase not required.
-You must be one of the first five people to complete all three steps.
-Each winner will receive 1 free key no later than 11-18-2022. We will be announcing the winners on 11-18-2022 through the community announcement board.
-The five winners will receive a direct message through the “Veterans for VR relaxation” group. If you do not own the Exhale XR ┃ VR Wellness app you are eligible for the app, but not the guided meditation.
-If you own the app you are eligible for “Return to the Now”, a guided meditation in the Wellness Library (DLC). 
-Each winner will receive 1 free key no later than 11-18-2022. We will be announcing the winners on 11-18-2022 through the community announcement board.
-The five winners will receive a direct message through the “Veterans for VR relaxation” group.
-All participants must adhere to the steam key policies when receiving a winning key. The key may not be given away by the winner.

notes.title: Exhale XR Release Date | Friday October 14th
notes.content:
The long awaited release of Exhale XR is happening later today, Friday the 14th. We have worked hard to bring you a VR wellness app that can be not only enjoyable and fun but more importantly an app that players can use as a new tool within their daily mental health routines for better days. 

We look forward to seeing players' personal experiences, on the community hub, with game play videos, screenshot grabs and feedback from your personal experiences with the Exhale XR app and the VR Wellness Library. 

Keep up to date with player rewards, milestone marks, events and more on the Exhale XR community hub here on Steam.

notes.title: Exhale XR Full Release | October 2022
notes.content:
Not only can you expect the [b]main Exhale XR game to release in mid October[/b] but Exhale will [b]also[/b] be [b]releasing the wellness library as 70+ dlc’s, the same day! [/b]Combined, that’s over 13 hours of immersive 360° retreats for players to experience at their leisure. Accent your personalized experience and intentions with the perfect accompanying retreat or guided meditation.

[previewyoutube=UFl1e-fT5ZI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] [b]Want to know a little bit more about the app's intended purposes?[/b] 
Ease anxiety or stress. Find a calm center to better focus for the day. Decrease insomnia with our sleep aids. Enjoy the breathing orb exercises. Challenge phobias like “fear of heights” or a dislike for “confined spaces” in a safe structured environment that is VR exposure therapy. No matter your main intention for use, Exhale XR will soon be an option for all to decompress from reality for a bit.
